title: Mod Mod Mod
statementMd:
You are given a sequence of integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Let ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8767bb4afef7bf6fc8660faf93bd6c301ca33b64.png), and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fee957ce3bd2c5eda97de1361a029a3ce8188743.png) for $1 ≤ *i* < *n*$. Here, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f52a9a86d828a54c4bc7e70dc407e45e8e5464a6.png) denotes the modulus operation. Find the maximum value of $*f*(*x*, 1)$ over all nonnegative integers $*x*$.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200000$) — the length of the sequence.

The second lines contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{13}$) — the elements of the sequence.

## Output

Output a single integer — the maximum value of $*f*(*x*, 1)$ over all nonnegative integers $*x*$.

## Note

In the first example you can choose, for example, $*x* = 19$.

In the second example you can choose, for example, $*x* = 3$ or $*x* = 2$.
